cell.format: 18650 commercial source; 18 mm harvested electrodes in laboratory cells

cell.match_evidence: Explicit LG MJ1 model and common DLR/SINTEF collection. Direct characterization identifies harvested cell #001; fit records link to their GITT processing chain. No intact-cell validation specimen correspondence established.
cell.note: No same-study intact MJ1 full-cell trace imported. Three-electrode GITT is electrode-versus-Li voltage, with a 260 um replacement separator; it is not an original commercial-cell validation trace. Do not combine all diffusion variants.

coverage.full_cell_tests: No intact commercial-cell test verified. Structured anode GITT inspected: t/I/working-versus-Li voltage only, no measured T or intact-cell CC cycle.
